name: codepet
description: Your pixel-art coding pet lives in VS Code. Tracks coding sessions, maps skills, and shows daily insights powered by the Codepet MCP server.
author: MURROR <hello@murror.app>

commands.title: Codepet: Set ElevenLabs API Key (for voice transcription)
Codepet: Set Deepgram API Key (for voice transcription)
Codepet: Set OpenAI API Key (for voice transcription)

codepet.idleTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes of inactivity before showing a session summary

codepet.showNotifications.description: Show notification popups for session summaries

codepet.periodicRefreshSeconds.description: How often to refresh MCP data (seconds)

codepet.mcpDataDir.description: Custom path to .codepet data directory (leave empty for ~/.codepet)

codepet.scanNotifications.description: Show notifications when the code scanner detects errors

codepet.scanOnType.description: Scan code as you type (debounced). Disable for scan-on-save only.

codepet.userName.description: Your name (shown in the welcome greeting). Leave blank for 'Coder'.

codepet.showWelcome.description: Show the personalized welcome screen when opening the editor.

codepet.syncIntervalSeconds.description: How often to sync session data to Firestore (seconds).

codepet.autoLinkApp.description: Automatically link with the Codepet macOS app (reads your account, name, and pet from the app).

codepet.breakReminderMinutes.description: Minutes of continuous coding before your pet reminds you to take a break. Set to 0 to disable.

enumDescriptions: Show the Codepet-designed welcome card inside the sidebar (recommended).
Show VS Code's system notification popup only.
Show both the sidebar card and the system popup.
Don't show a welcome at all.
codepet.welcomeStyle.description: How Codepet greets you when VS Code starts.

codepet.elevenlabsApiKey.markdownDescription: ElevenLabs API key for voice-to-text transcription (Scribe). For better security, use the **Codepet: Set ElevenLabs API Key** command instead (stores in VS Code SecretStorage). Get one at https://elevenlabs.io/app/settings/api-keys

codepet.elevenlabsModel.description: ElevenLabs Scribe model used for voice transcription.

codepet.deepgramApiKey.markdownDescription: Deepgram API key for voice-to-text transcription (generous free tier). For better security, use the **Codepet: Set Deepgram API Key** command instead (stores in VS Code SecretStorage). Get one at https://console.deepgram.com/signup

codepet.deepgramModel.description: Deepgram model used for voice transcription.

codepet.openaiApiKey.markdownDescription: OpenAI API key for voice-to-text transcription (Whisper). Stored in VS Code settings. For better security, use the **Codepet: Set OpenAI API Key** command instead (stores in VS Code SecretStorage).

codepet.whisperModel.description: OpenAI model used for voice transcription.
